dct_description_sm: This layer illustrates the delineation of individual lots and concessions as polygon features. Each polygon is associated with attributes such as the lot number, concession number, township name, and combined concession and lot identifiers. The data facilitates understanding land divisions and boundary delineations within the municipality.
